about: Published vulnerabilities in what a deployment installs that are NOT fixed yet, each with why it cannot reach a user of this app and a date to look again. scripts/qa/dependencies.mjs fails on an entry past its date, and on an entry for something no longer reported. Emptied 2026-10-23: next 15.5.27 -> 15.5.28 fixed a critical advisory (an RCE in image optimisation with SVG, and a server-action DoS), and postcss and deepmerge-ts are pinned to their fixed releases beneath Next and Prisma's config loader (package.json `overrides`), which cleared the four entries accepted on 2026-10-13 (postcss, deepmerge-ts, @prisma/config, prisma).
